document.title: Multi 9 - Sistema apparecchiature modulari
document.pages: Printed 15: 3P selection row 16 A / curve C and diagram E45095

modelingNotes: Exact order 24284: C60N, 3P, 16 A, curve C, catalog printed p.15. Manufacturer legacy product page independently confirms identity: https://www.se.com/th/en/product/24284/c60-circuit-breaker-c60n-3p-16a-c-curve/

Printed p.15 diagram E45095 explicitly marks three mechanically ganged switched poles 1-2, 3-4, 5-6. Numeric keys preserve markings; upper/lower refer only to the drawing, not mandatory feed direction or assigned phases. Open state follows the catalog symbol and is not an asserted as-installed handle state.

Complete connection coverage is scoped to the standalone breaker: six power terminals; no neutral, PE, control, signal or communication terminals shown for this order. Optional auxiliary/release/residual-current assemblies are outside this order model. Passive power connections are application-dependent, so none is universally required.

16 A nominal current at 30 deg C; curve C magnetic operation 5-10 In. Source for ratings: catalog printed p.14, https://img.yumpu.com/16219073/16/1200x1600/multi-9-sistema-apparecchiature-modulari.jpg

For 3P: CEI EN 60898 Icn 6000 A at 400 V AC; CEI EN 60947-2 Icu 20 kA at 230-240 V AC, 10 kA at 400-415 V AC. Catalog Ue 400 V AC, Ui 500 V AC, Uimp 6 kV. Conditional capabilities are notes, not assigned circuit voltage; no nominal_voltage or AC-only restriction is encoded.
For In up to 25 A, cage terminals accept up to 16 mm2 flexible or 25 mm2 rigid conductors. No conductor-count or tightening-torque claim is made.
Contact functions and mechanical ganging create no permanent continuity. No fixed links. Protective dynamics, coordination and installation suitability are not simulated.

connectionCoverage.notes: Standalone 24284: six numbered main power terminals in three switched poles. No accessory assemblies included; no neutral, PE, control or communication connection in the documented breaker circuit.
